headline: UnrealIRCd flaw now exploited on its KEV due date; LiteLLM scans and an AI-agent API key theft campaign; FBI ARTEX warning still leads

bullets.text: New: UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 is now being exploited in attacks (SecurityWeek). Its federal KEV deadline is today, 11-16, the same day as Check Point CVE-2026-123039 (PHP2Shell), used to gain root on gateways and deploy an ESXi wiper.
New: SANS reports scans for LiteLLM/Starlette CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, and Amazon uncovered an AI agent campaign targeting LiteLLM, Dify and other apps for API keys.

New: BO Team exploited Log4Shell in VMware vCenter and compromised a Russian firm's code-signing server. Separately, hackers are probing newly disclosed Copeland refrigeration controller flaws, and six unpatched Danfoss controller flaws allow takeover without login.

Breaches: Australian retailer Coles is investigating a cybersecurity incident; Uber's breach impacts 150,000 people; Qilin claims UT Arlington. TSMC's cloud-provider-linked employee data breach and the 22 million-person French postal hack remain on the board.
Developing: the FBI warning that the ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering cyberattacks worldwide remains the only 3-outlet story. The last 7 days score 0.99x the 90-day average.
Still active: Cursor says a stolen Fireworks AI key led to the trojanized Claude Code extension incident.

actions: UnrealIRCd: patch CVE-2026-114713 or take internet-facing servers offline today, and check them for signs of exploitation.
Check Point: apply the CVE-2026-123039 fix today if not done, restrict management access and hunt for backdoors; keep ESXi backups offline.
LiteLLM, Dify and similar AI gateways: patch CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, keep admin endpoints off the internet and rotate stored API keys.
VMware vCenter: confirm Log4Shell is remediated and review access to code-signing servers and keys.
Copeland and Danfoss refrigeration controllers: remove them from internet exposure and segment them until fixes are available.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
